revision_notes: Incorporates project-held Bloomberg DES reference material dated 14 July 2026 for CH, COT, HB, NG, OQA, U6, XBW and ZS.
Instrument records retain their documented structural-window definitions and uncertainty flags.
CH and HB are option-support clone/mirror chains rather than independent commodity exposures; XBW is a Bloomberg-constructed alias of XB; COT is Brent TAS rather than an outright Brent price.
London clock times remain reference conversions. Production code should construct boundaries from named source time zones and date-specific DST rules.

exclude_from_outright_pair_screening.CH: Clone of NY Harbor ULSD futures used to house crack-spread options; canonical outright root is HO.
exclude_from_outright_pair_screening.COT: ICE Brent Trade-at-Settlement differential, not an outright futures price; values may be zero or negative and should not be log-transformed as an outright price.
exclude_from_outright_pair_screening.HB: Mirror of current NYMEX WTI crude futures used solely to price European-style options; canonical outright root is CL.

deduplicate.XBW: Bloomberg-constructed series representing NYMEX RBOB gasoline XB from October 2006 onward; canonical root is XB.

retain_with_market_structure_flags.OQA: GME Oman crude benchmark; retain as an outright crude future.
retain_with_market_structure_flags.U6: MCX INR-denominated WTI-linked crude future; retain only with explicit currency/session treatment.
retain_with_market_structure_flags.ZS: MCX INR-denominated Henry-Hub-linked natural-gas future; retain only with explicit currency/session treatment.
